signature.name: VTask.subtypePreimage
signature.type: {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β)

conventions.statement: The forward direction of the equivalence restricts a constrained function x : α → β to its values on {a // ¬p a}, discarding the (fixed) behaviour on {a // p a}.
conventions.note: This is the natural projection that forgets the pinned part.

conventions.statement: The inverse map, applied to y : {a // ¬p a} → β, produces a total function that on elements a with p a returns x₀ ⟨a, h⟩.
The inverse map, applied to y : {a // ¬p a} → β, produces a total function that on elements a with ¬p a returns y ⟨a, h⟩.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {β : Type} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : {a // p a} → β) (y : {a // ¬p a} → β) (a : α) (h : p a), ((VTask.subtypePreimage p x₀).symm y : α → β) a = x₀ ⟨a, h⟩
